items.title: Could You Have Seen Merck Stock's Pipeline Run Coming?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock gained about 89% in the year from mid-September 2025, against a 17.1% price gain for the S&P 500. It also beat Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), up 58%, and Eli Lilly (LLY), up 54%. The signs were public long before the run, in what management kept saying about its drug pipeline. The reported sales told a different story.

items.title: Reflecting On Therapeutics Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV)
items.summary: Earnings results often indicate what direction a company will take in the months ahead. With Q2 behind us, let’s have a look at AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) and its peers.

items.title: Why Is JNJ Stock Beating Rivals That Grow Faster?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has returned 58% over the past twelve months, second best in a group of six health care companies. Its revenue growth ranks only fourth of the six. Three peers grew faster and returned less, Eli Lilly among them. The price is a bet that the rest of the business keeps growing once shrinking STELARA sales stop dragging on the total.

items.title: AbbVie Secures EU Approval for Rinvoq in Juvenile Arthritis
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) announced on Tuesday that the European Commission has approved Rinvoq (upadacitinib) for the treatment of active polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis. The approval covers children aged two years and older who have had an inadequate response to one or more disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs).

items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $200,000 Salary With Dividends?
items.summary: Replacing a top-tier salary with dividends sounds like a portfolio problem, but the yield you chase could cost you far more than the shares you buy. The answer depends on a tradeoff most investors never think to run.
